input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 provides automatic renewal but requires 90 days' prior written notice of non-renewal, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window (and is far from our preferred 30-day opt-out with a 60-day vendor reminder). The renewal clause itself does not permit any renewal uplift — renewal is for a term equal in duration to the previous term on existing terms — so the price-increase element is not engaged; IBM's separate unilateral price-change right in § 13.1 (after 12 months, on 90 days' notice, with a fee-free Customer exit) is a change-of-terms mechanic addressed elsewhere and is not double-flagged here. We have made the single minimal change to the notice window; we note but do not redline that renewal terms mirror the initial term length rather than being capped at 12 months, which is a preferred-level point only.

ops.oldText: at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
ops.newText: at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days so we are not locked into another automatic renewal term by an early deadline; 60 days is our fallback position (our preferred is 30 days with a vendor reminder).
proposal.summary: Shorten the non-renewal notice window in § 3.2 from 90 to 60 days.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment
